frozen_entity_membership.details: Evaluated strictly the 300 pre-registered entities from results/phase4/confirmatory_protocol.json without replacement or resampling.

zero_leakage_and_quarantine.details: Confirmatory data was never touched during training, checkpoint selection, or threshold tuning. All checkpoints and models were frozen in Phase 3/4.

timestamp_and_causality.details: All windows span [5100s, 10800s] on the 300s discrete grid with 15 strictly trailing steps. Zero future observations used at prediction time.

post_failure_exclusion.details: Zero post-failure telemetry was labeled or evaluated as early detection. All post-failure steps were correctly classified as UNKNOWN (-1) and excluded.

metric_denominators.details: All denominators verified: 2,596 windows, 188 pure-normal entities, 0 failure episodes.

prevalence_adjustment.details: Prevalence adjustments reported separately using documented 0.5% production prevalence assumption as sensitivity analysis.

findings.failure_pool_lifespan_limitation: The Borg 2011 trace exhibits short task lifespans for failing jobs. Tasks that fail typically do so in their first 10-45 minutes. Consequently, zero unpadded 75-minute history windows could be extracted strictly before failure from the untouched holdout entities.
